architecture.approach: Parse a strict YAML 1.2 core subset into an ordered value tree, deserialize it through serde, and keep yaml::Error independent of diag with line, column, and byte offset. Add GitHub Actions CI, contributor and security surfaces, license files, complete package metadata, and a manual release runbook.

dataModel.flowDescription: Source text flows through a lexer and parser into an ordered YamlValue tree, then through a serde deserializer into the target type. Failures become yaml::Error with a stable code, message, line, column, and byte offset. No data is stored or transmitted.

securityConsiderations.description: Treat YAML as untrusted input; enforce a depth limit of 128; return positioned errors instead of panicking or hanging.
Every parse error carries line, column, and byte offset for precise diagnostics.
Keep dado I/O-free so parsing cannot fetch, write, or exfiltrate data.
Error messages never echo scalar values; no secret file or committed token is introduced.
CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN comes from the environment or GitHub Secrets only.

performanceConsiderations.strategy: Bound recursive descent with a depth limit of 128 and avoid unbounded backtracking in the supported grammar.
Cache Cargo dependencies and cancel superseded CI runs to keep the three-OS matrix practical.

risks.description: YAML grammar complexity causes parser bugs or ambiguous behavior.
risks.mitigation: Implement the documented subset only; reject the rest with positioned errors; test every edge case in the specification.

risks.description: MSRV 1.85 breaks because a dependency raises its minimum Rust version.
risks.mitigation: Run a dedicated MSRV job; pin or downgrade only with a recorded decision.

risks.description: dado is taken on crates.io before publication.
risks.mitigation: Check the name immediately before publish; stop and ask for a fallback if taken.

risks.description: Publishing is irreversible and a bad release cannot be deleted.
risks.mitigation: Require a dry-run, clean main, review, manual runbook, and cargo yank for rollback.

risks.description: Three-OS CI increases cost and runtime.
risks.mitigation: Use dependency caching and concurrency cancellation.

risks.description: Scope creeps into wirekit or other crates.
risks.mitigation: Enforce the out-of-scope list; later work becomes a new feature.
Use CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN from the environment or GitHub Secrets; never commit .env or tokens.

risks.description: Deeply nested input overflows the stack.
risks.mitigation: Enforce a depth limit of 128 and return a positioned error.
